status: owner-requested targeted corrections; not exhaustive certification

add.text: Select Flex withdrawals are limited to 50% of profit and a fixed per-request cap ($2,500 for a 50K account purchased after September 1, 2026). Select Daily also has a per-request cap.
Select Flex requires five winning days (at least $150 per day on 50K); Select Daily requires a $2,100 buffer on 50K. Both require positive net profit in subsequent payout cycles.
add.locator: Select Flex — Winning Day Threshold; Select Daily — Buffer System; Shared Rule

add.text: Select Flex and Select Daily simulated funded accounts use an end-of-day trailing drawdown, which locks after reaching the specified profit threshold or requesting a payout.
add.locator: Trailing Max Drawdowns — funded Select accounts

add.text: Quick Pay simulated funded accounts use an intraday trailing maximum drawdown until the floor reaches the starting balance; Fast Pass funded accounts also use a trailing drawdown.
add.locator: Quick Pay / Fast Pass — Funded accounts and drawdowns

add.text: Section 6 allows payout refusal for suspected rule breaches or strategy manipulation. Section 10 provides an email appeal with a response within ten business days; the decision is final.
Funded accounts must meet a withdrawal profit threshold ($2,500 on 50K) and a minimum transfer of $1,000 of the trader's share.
Funded traders must keep their account balance above a trailing drawdown calculated in real time; the floor stops trailing at the specified level.
Under Reward Interview, refusing an interview of up to 60 minutes may lead to payout denial and closure of any account held by the trader.
The August 19, 2026 dashboard policy states that on funded accounts the first failure to place a stop loss within two minutes cancels the payout and the account.
add.locator: Operational rule softbreaches — 2-minute Stop Loss rule

add.text: Section 4 prohibits trading that harms broker relationships, as well as undefined excessive risk relative to account norms; violations may lead to profit forfeiture and account termination.
The Anti-disparagement and conduct clause explicitly covers negative reviews on public platforms; a breach can result in immediate termination, profit forfeiture or legal action.

Sections 5.2 and 5.4 allow case-by-case assessment of oversized or binary-outcome trades and withholding or voiding of profits for breaches. Section 3.4 allows appeal within ten business days of suspension or closure.

General Terms V17 Article XXIV incorporates Appendix 2 for all contracts, surviving for two years. Appendix 2 prohibits public criticism including negative reviews and provides for recovery of damages, costs and legal fees.
add.locator: V17 Article XXIV; Appendix 2 §§2–3 (archived PDF, 25 Nov 2026)

add.text: Section 38 reserves the right to amend withdrawal limits on funded simulated accounts at the company's discretion without prior notice.
add.locator: §38 — Withdrawals from Funded Simulated Trading Accounts

add.text: Section 38 limits funded simulated withdrawals to 15% of nominal account size per 21-day period; excess profit stays on the account for a later request.

Sections 17.3–17.4 state that performance rewards are discretionary, not guaranteed and subject to sole approval; the platform may approve, adjust, delay or decline any performance reward at its discretion.

The Reserve Bank of India Alert List, updated November 19, 2025, lists FTMO at entry 13. The list concerns forex authorization or promotion of unauthorized platforms in India; it is not a finding of payout misconduct.
